title: The Lights Of New York Doesn't Get Enough Credit

commenti.body:
>Think about it. When you ask the average person what the first talking film is they automatically say The Jazz Singer. And yet that film was 95% silent with two brief talking lines improvised by Al Jolson.

Lol.  No they don't.

Even film historians overlook The Lights of New York.  Any documentary about film history mentions The Jazz Singer but may only mention this film in passing.  The fact that you're the only person who has replied in 16 hours just re enforces how overlooked it is.
